transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um… I guess what finally made me make the appointment is I’ve been forgetting little things I usually keep on top of. Like returning phone calls, or turning in a registration form, or remembering to stop for an errand on my way home. It’s not anything huge, I don’t think, but it’s been happening enough that I thought maybe I should ask someone about it.
Have you noticed any other changes in your thinking, memory, or ability to handle your usual responsibilities?

I mean, overall I’m still getting by okay, I think. I’m not… dropping everything or anything like that. But there have been some little work follow-ups I’ve missed, and a few school-related deadlines or forms that slipped by me. It’s enough that I’ve started worrying people might see me as unreliable, which I really don’t want. I’ve been hoping to maybe move toward an Office Manager role eventually, so I guess I’m scared it could affect that if it keeps happening.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy lately?
Um… no, I don’t think so. I mean, I have normal stressful days, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling really down or not enjoying things. At least, nothing that stood out to me like that.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating, making decisions, or thinking clearly lately?

A little, yeah. I don’t know if I’d call it thinking clearly exactly, but I do get pulled off track pretty easily. Like at work, if a phone rings or people are talking nearby, suddenly I’ve lost where I was in what I was doing. Or even in class, some random thought about something I need to do at home can kind of take me away from the task. It’s not all the time, but… enough that I notice it.
Have you found yourself feeling restless, fidgety, or having trouble staying seated when you need to?

A little, I guess. Not like I can’t stay seated or anything, but in longer classes I do notice I’ll start clicking my pen, or bouncing my foot, or shifting around in the chair even when I’m trying to just sit still and pay attention. I hope that’s not too unusual, but… yeah, I’ve noticed it.
When did you first start noticing these kinds of difficulties, like trouble staying focused or feeling restless? Were they something you experienced earlier in life, like in school as a child?

I think it goes back pretty far, actually. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it was, because I did get through school okay, but even in elementary school I was kind of that kid who would forget permission slips or lose homework in my backpack. My mom or my teacher would have to remind me step by step to finish projects sometimes. I guess I just thought that was me being a little scattered, if that makes sense.
